Use `AGENTS.md`, `TASKS.md`, and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` as the source of truth.
This repository is a narrow property-based transaction testkit for side-effecting
AI agents—not a general eval platform. Keep core deterministic, local-first,
framework-neutral, JSON-serializable, and fully tested. Commit-aware fault
semantics and validity-preserving shrinking are product invariants.
